notes.title: Star Chef Simulator | The Asian Food Update
notes.content:
The Asian Food Update (v0.4.0(.1)) is now available. This is the third major content update and the biggest one so far. We've added new dishes, many customization options and new cooking mechanics. Enjoy making Sushi with the Bamboo Mat or cooking Rice with the Rice Cooker. Our team has collected feedback from content creators and the community to add quality of life features and improve the over all game flow!

Bug Fixes:

 Fixed some walls not updating correctly when customizing them
 Fixed bug of window mode not updating correctly
 Fixed bug of Linux version not starting correctly
 Fixed bug that tree shadows disappeared sometimes
 Fixed wrong translations
 Fixed bug of storeman teleporting into bins
 Fixed bug of keybinding mouse icons not showing correctly sometimes

 Fixed bug of subtitle widget preventing you from exiting tooltip widgets at 150% UI scale

 Fixed bug of pinned recipe not updating correctly in shop app

 Fixed bug of customer groups being counted as one in statistics
 Finally fixed bug of level up animation not waiting until game unpaused or time skipping finished
 Items can no longer get attached on a new crockery when already on a crockery

Improvements:

 Added animation for keybinding buttons
 Edited some groceries icons
 Added sound when transfering from package box
 Some texture loading optimization
 Adjusted random skill values of employee applications

 Added "(p)" to all recipes if grocery is needed partially only
 Decreased size of UI elements on personalization screen (first startup)
 New design of news section in main menu

 Added one new wall texture for customization

notes.title: Star Chef Simulator | Community Update 02
notes.content:
The Asian Food Update (March)
It has been some time since the last update and we would like to share some information about the latest development. We're actively working on The Asian Food Update, which will be the third major content update and is ought to release in March. There will be more dishes, new customization options for your restaurant, many level design improvements, and much more cool stuff - stay tuned!
However, the update will be slightly smaller than the last major updates, as we're preparing for the updates in Q2, Q3, and the Bakery DLC in Q4 in the background. Thanks for your patience!

Steam Cloud Support Update
Star Chef Simulator now supports the Steam Cloud for Linux, to store save games across devices & different platforms. This means you're able to continue running your restaurant on SteamOS (Steam Deck), Windows or Linux and v. v.

notes.title: Star Chef Simulator | #starchefpic Event
notes.content:
Do you have a special screenshot of Star Chef Simulator that everyone should definitely see? Then join our Discord server (linked below) and send your picture with the hashtag #starchefpic in the channel #star-chef-simulator-chat. This is a community event. If our team likes your submission, it may end up in the game's loading screen!

Please consider following requirements before submitting a screenshot:

 Min. resolution: FullHD (1920x1080 / Scaling 16:9)
 Discord name & screenshot content must comply with the server rules
 Please do not submit the same screenshot more than once

Thank you for submitting!

By submitting a screenshot, you agree that the shown content and your Discord name may be displayed in the Star Chef Simulator loading screen and in other postings by Division Software.
